comment: The release archives of the template release that hyper uses (kit K140, H23.11-2): the php-ext zip, which make hyper-install unpacks into var/products/template-ext for make ext, and the php zip in the Composer artifact repository var/products/template-php of composer.json and examples/board/composer.json. TEMPLATE_TAG of the Makefile reads the version of template-php. Each archive has one entry.
